subject: Mid-quarter OKR snapshot: alignment asks, re-scope proposals, and dependency log
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Mid-quarter OKR snapshot: alignment asks, re-scope proposals, and dependency log

Team —

Following our weekly steer sync, I took a pass through the Q4 OKR tracker and pulled a short list of places we need leadership alignment and concrete unblock asks for the next two weeks. I know everyone's heads are full, so this is intentionally short and prescriptive. Please reply inline with: 1) a one-sentence status, 2) whether you support the proposed re-scope (yes/no/partial), and 3) any dependency owners you need me to escalate.

High-level slices:
- Product Reach (O1): proposal to narrow the GA feature set to the top 2 integrations to preserve latency SLAs. Rationale: current implementation work + infra stabilization running behind plan.
- Serving Cost (O2): recommend postponing multi-model auto-routing until H1 to prioritize KV cache improvements that cut token cost by an estimated 9%.
- Enterprise Reliability (O3): critical - need SOC2 artifact handoff and a signed SOW from BrightDesk to start onshore deployment testing.

Concrete asks: 
A) Vanessa — confirm resource trade (frontload one infra engineer for 3 weeks) and whether you can approve this re-assignment by EOD Wednesday.
B) Markus — we need your read on the QA runway; can we shrink the GA acceptance criteria list as proposed in the attached tracker?
C) Tessa — procurement/contract side: can you surface any remaining BrightDesk legal/PO blockers? We still need an SOW signed to start onshore validation.

Attachments: Q4_OKR_tracker_v3.xlsx (tracker with proposed scoping columns).

Goal for this thread: by end of day Tuesday have clear binary decisions and a single list of dependency owners so I can escalate anything that needs VP attention.

Thanks —
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Head of Platform Product
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter OKR snapshot: alignment asks, re-scope proposals, and dependency log

Chloe —

Thanks for the concise plan. Quick responses below: 

1) Product Reach (O1) — status: 60% on integration adapters, blocked on the region-specific auth flow for BrightDesk. Support re-scope: partial (support narrowing to top 2 integrations, but we should keep lightweight hooks for the 3rd to avoid rework). Dependency owners to escalate: Sara Patel (BrightDesk PM) for auth flow spec; Engineering: Arjun Patel (infra).

2) Serving Cost (O2) — status: cache prototype shows the 9% savings you call out in staging. Support re-scope: yes, prioritize KV cache fixes. I can allocate Daniel (infra engineer) 60% for 3 weeks starting Nov 29 if Markus confirms QA runway.

3) Enterprise Reliability (O3) — status: SOC2 docs are queued; legal asked for the signed SOW to map controls to BrightDesk environment. Support re-scope: n/a (this is a blocker we can't postpone). Dependency owners: Tessa to follow up with Procurement; BrightDesk procurement contact is procurement@brightdesk.com.

I approve the resource trade in principle pending final sign-off Tuesday AM.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Customer Success & GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter OKR snapshot: alignment asks, re-scope proposals, and dependency log

Folks —

Quick QA runway check: we are at ~2.5 weeks of test design and automation backlog to hit the original acceptance criteria for GA. I support the proposed scoping down of GA acceptance; the two integrations approach reduces test surface by ~40% which aligns with the resource shift Vanessa proposed.

Notes: 
- If Daniel is allocated Nov 29, we can accelerate a test harness for cache regression tests and target a short validation window in week 2 of December.
- Risk: narrowing integrations means fewer in-prod permutations. We should lock in a canary cohort that includes BrightDesk since they're the first enterprise pilot — need the signed SOW to proceed.

Action items I will take before EOD Tuesday: an updated QA acceptance checklist (will attach to the tracker) and an estimated regression test runtimes table.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, QA Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Patel <sara@brightdesk.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightdesk.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter OKR snapshot: alignment asks, re-scope proposals, and dependency log

Hi Chloe / team —

Appreciate the clarity. From BrightDesk side: 
- Auth flow spec: we can finalize by Nov 24; I will share the spec doc and an integration checklist.
- SOW: procurement confirms they have the draft (BrightDesk_SOW_Draft.pdf) and need one minor redline on datalog retention and an explicit validation plan for onshore testing. Procurement timeline: we can sign the SOW by Dec 1 if Redwood can accept the retention clause tweak and provide a short validation plan by Nov 29.

We are fully supportive of being the canary cohort. I will loop in our legal lead if you’d like a quick sync — otherwise we will respond to the SOW redline in the shared doc by EOD Monday.

Best,
Sara Patel
Head of Product
BrightDesk
